description: This file contains the PHP class 'SubscriptionPlan' which is part of the OpenCart system's catalog model. It provides methods for retrieving subscription plan data from the database, including fetching individual plans, multiple plans with filtering and sorting, and counting total plans. The class extends the system's engine model and interacts with multiple database tables related to subscription plans.

classes.name: SubscriptionPlan
classes.description: Provides methods to interact with and retrieve subscription plan data from the database.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlan
methods.description: Fetches a single subscription plan by its ID, including description specific to the current language.

methods.name: getSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Retrieves a list of subscription plans with optional filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalSubscriptionPlans
methods.description: Returns the total count of subscription plans.
